title: How-to Guides for Specific Audiences: A Corpus and Initial Findings

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of topical and vocabulary differences, quantitative measurement of text overlap using BLEU scores, and training text classification models (Logistic Regression, RoBERTa) to extract and analyze highly predictive linguistic features (content and style) that distinguish instructional articles aimed at women versus men.

Qualitative analysis of topical differences, quantitative measurement of article length and text overlap (BLEU), and extracting predictive linguistic features from text classification models to identify systematic stylistic and content differences between instructions written for kids versus teenagers.
